title: P256 72-bit grid: mined public X pairs, block transport, LDEC label tables

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P256 target, uniform Q and fresh coins, recover x with success at least0.39 at expected total work at most33520726960141024519068360637324657420515 scalar instructions, below2^124.656392947769967 group units (C1000); every run below2^181.6668 units. N=2^72, MX=1024 permanent points, G=1085 groups of 1024 Y-chains, L=95000000. Phase 0 (charged, capped, abort without padding) mines2^14 public X pairs with0<x2-x1<2^64; Q is carried by the chains; the backward pass uses the one-word delta. Gate K=7197141370394540364 precedes worker startup; closed cost64. Single epoch;2300032 records/slot; CAP_H=ceil(m_h)+2^41+G*2^36; K2 mod2^58; label error within[-24,10] (34 bad residues mod2^17). Chen-Stein on good collisions of Gamma' (label-error classes excluded); second-moment candidate/request/relay rows with Lemma M's factors; CAND_CAP=2^27, REQ_CAP=2^29. Both hops move128-record blocks; the home joins each block with a next array (walk on K2, K3 checked on a K2 hit). Hot records omit sign and one X-index bit; source recovery enumerates four leaves and rejects ambiguity, with exact B45 success loss and2^22 extra instructions per served request; at most 2*N*CAND_CAP requests are served over the run and all are charged. The label path is the LDEC form x(X+-Y)=xX+c1 i+c2 w -/+ 2 yY (yX w) with per-X 7-window label tables for c1 i (and T(xX)) and for c2 w riding in the canonical yX*w scan; the cross term keeps the Y entry's 2yY rows. Algorithm and full accounting are proof.md and included appendices: disclosed history-conditional H_T (3.5 per incidence), Weil's bound in Lemma W, ideal coins, blocking ports, LSE, listed LS64 locations and256-byte DC ZVA. All processors, construction, failures, transfers and verification included without amortization; memory below2^138bytes, preprocessing below2^120units included, no advice or auxiliary input.

experiments.purpose: Check grid72 records, source sign/X-bit recovery, full finite kernels/protocols with the one-word delta step, Phase 0's dictionary, caps, collector and rule on real points, and the exact E-ledger.
